description: Scoring logic and tier definitions for resource ratings

metrics.name: Beginner Friendliness
metrics.description: How easy for a newcomer to get started

scoring.1: Requires deep prior knowledge. No docs for beginners. Steep learning curve.
scoring.2: Some prior knowledge needed. Tutorials exist but are scattered.
scoring.3: Average learning curve. Official docs cover basics. Some onboarding friction.
scoring.4: Good onboarding. Clear docs + example projects. Most users get started in minutes.
scoring.5: Exceptional onboarding. Interactive tutorials, sample apps, generous free tier to experiment. Zero to production in minutes.

metrics.name: Documentation Quality
metrics.description: Quality, completeness, and clarity of documentation

scoring.1: No docs or extremely outdated. Community sources only.
scoring.2: Minimal docs exist. Missing key sections. No code examples.
scoring.3: Adequate docs. Covers basic usage. Some gaps in advanced features.
scoring.4: Well-organized docs. Quick start, API reference, guides, and examples. Searchable.
scoring.5: Exceptional docs. Interactive examples, video guides, SDK references, troubleshooting guides, live playground, and community-run wiki.

metrics.name: Free Tier Generosity
metrics.description: How generous the free tier is relative to typical usage

scoring.1: No free tier exists, or free tier is essentially unusable (< 10 requests or 24-hour trial).
scoring.2: Existing free tier but severely limited (< 100 requests/mo or < 50 MB storage).
scoring.3: Reasonable free tier for small projects (1k requests/mo or 500 MB storage).
scoring.4: Generous free tier suitable for production prototyping (10k+ requests/mo or 2 GB+ storage).
scoring.5: Extremely generous. Can run a real product on free tier indefinitely. No card required. 100k+ requests or 5 GB+ storage.

metrics.name: Setup Ease
metrics.description: Time and effort required to integrate and start using

scoring.1: Complex setup requiring multiple tools, environments, or manual configuration. Days to integrate.
scoring.2: Moderate setup. Multiple config steps. Hours to integrate.
scoring.3: Standard setup. CLI or SDK install. ~30 minutes to integrate.
scoring.4: Quick setup. One-line install or SDK import. ~10 minutes to first working example.
scoring.5: Instant setup. No config needed. Copy-paste snippet works immediately. < 5 minutes.

metrics.name: Reliability
metrics.description: Uptime, consistency, and trustworthiness of the service

scoring.1: Frequent outages, data loss risks, or abandoned project. < 90% uptime.
scoring.3: Acceptable reliability. Occasional blips. 95-99% uptime. SLA available (may be paid).
scoring.4: High reliability. Rare issues. 99.5%+ uptime. Clear status page.
scoring.5: Enterprise-grade reliability. 99.99%+ uptime. Multi-region redundancy. Public status page. Incident response within minutes.

metrics.name: Performance
metrics.description: Speed, latency, and responsiveness of the tool

scoring.1: Very slow. High latency. Free tier is throttled to unusable speeds.
scoring.2: Slow. Noticeable latency. Free tier has significant rate limiting.
scoring.3: Acceptable performance. Moderate latency. Free tier rate limits are reasonable.
scoring.4: Fast. Low latency. Free tier has minimal throttling.
scoring.5: Blazing fast. Sub-100ms responses. Global edge network. No perceivable throttling on free tier.

metrics.name: Community
metrics.description: Size, activity, and helpfulness of the community

scoring.1: No community. No forums, Discord, or GitHub discussions. No third-party content.
scoring.2: Small community. Low activity. Response times > 1 week.
scoring.3: Moderate community. Active GitHub/Discord. Response within 1-2 days. Some tutorials.
scoring.4: Large, active community. Fast responses (< 24h). Many third-party tutorials, courses, and libraries.
scoring.5: Massive community. Responses in minutes. Official community managers. Rich ecosystem of plugins, extensions, courses, books, and conferences.

scoring.description: Overall score is calculated as a weighted average of all metric scores, rounded to one decimal place.

tiers.label: ⭐ Excellent
tiers.description: Highly recommended. Strong in most areas.

tiers.label: ⚠ Insufficient
tiers.description: Does not meet minimum quality bar.

rankings.description: To generate a category ranking, sort resources by overall score descending. Ties broken by free_generosity score.

aggregate.description: Aggregate scores for a category or subcategory are the mean of all resource scores within that group.
aggregate.display: Rounded to 1 decimal place with the corresponding tier badge
